description: New York ISO real-time zonal electricity prices from NYISO's public MIS files: the latest 5-minute LBMP ($/MWh) for each of the 15 zones and interfaces (CAPITL, N.Y.C., LONGIL, WEST...) with its loss and congestion components, plus the day's average so far per zone. Eastern time stamps; real-time market only (day-ahead not included). Related tools on this server, for a different need: energy_ercot_texas_grid_status when you need Live Texas grid status from ERCOT's public dashboards; energy_us_electric_grid_monitor when you need US electric grid monitor from EIA's Hourly Electric Grid. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

zone.description: Optional zone name, e.g. N.Y.C., LONGIL, CAPITL, WEST
